about_title: Barbers HUB is a space for independent barbers.
about_fact1_desc: Each with their own style. Each responsible for their own work.
about_fact2_desc: There are no middlemen here. It's you and the barber. We're a workspace for professionals.
about_text1: If you're a client — choose your barber and book.
about_text2: If you're a barber — if you know your craft, we might have space. Simple. Clear. No bullshit.
contacts_phone_note:
We might not answer — we're working.
Book online.
footer_for_barbers: Are you a barber? Explore chair rental.
v2_hero_title: Book a cut. Or build your independent chair.
v2_hero_text: A working barbershop for clients who value the craft, and for barbers who want freedom with a professional environment around them.
v2_clients_title: Choose your barber and book direct.
v2_clients_text: Barbers Hub is a professional workspace for independent barbers. Each barber owns their craft, their schedule, and their client relationship.
v2_location_text: Central Riga location with a working barbershop atmosphere.
v2_direct_text: You choose the barber. The barber does the work.
v2_barbers_title: Build your own barber business. Not by yourself.
v2_barbers_text: Keep your clients. Set your own prices. Build your own brand. Barbers HUB gives independent barbers a premium workspace plus business support so you can focus on cutting hair, improving your craft and earning more.
v2_fit_new_text: Build confidence and a loyal client base inside a real shop environment.
v2_fit_growing_text: Move toward independence without taking on every operational problem alone.
v2_fit_experienced_text: Use flexible access, full control, and a serious space as your base.
v2_story_title: You work freely inside a structured shop.
v2_story_text: Going independent should not mean doing everything alone. You focus on clients and craft; we keep the space professional, maintained, and ready for work.
v2_included_title: Support around the chair, not just the chair.
v2_growth_text: Work alongside skilled professionals, exchange knowledge, improve your confidence, and grow naturally inside a real barbershop atmosphere.
v2_pricing_title: Start with one day or make it your base.
v2_day_text: A full day to test independent work with your own clients.
v2_flex_text: For growing barbers who want flexibility while building consistency.
v2_resident_text: Unlimited 24/7 access for independent professionals ready to make the space their base.
v2_pricing_note: Additional business support services are optional and paid separately depending on your needs.
v2_tour_title: One day can change your career.
v2_tour_text: No pressure. No long-term commitment. Experience what working for yourself feels like.
v2_form_note: Send your details and we will contact you to arrange Independence Day.
v2_more_title: Your clients. Your income. Your pace.
v2_more_text: A space for barbers who want more freedom, more ownership, more growth, and more control over their future.
v2_principles_4: Respect the shared workspace and equipment.
v2_principles_note: Detailed terms and house rules are provided during onboarding and membership confirmation.
v2_whatsapp_label: Chat with Barbers HUB on WhatsApp
v2_form_opening_email: Opening an email draft so you can send your request.
v2_form_sent: Request sent. We will contact you to arrange Independence Day.
v2_form_email_fallback: Could not send the request directly. Opening an email draft instead.
v2_trust_text_1: Keep the relationships you have already built.
v2_trust_text_2: Set the value of your own work.
v2_trust_text_3: Work in a rhythm that fits your clients and goals.
v2_trust_text_4: Build toward earning more as your own business grows.
v2_business_title: Your business, backed by a serious workspace.
v2_business_text: Barbers HUB is for barbers who want control without being left alone with every operational problem. You bring your craft, your tools and your clients. We provide the environment and support around the chair.
v2_problem_title: Most chair rental shops stop at: “Here's your chair. Good luck.”
v2_problem_text: Barbers HUB is different. We remove the boring parts of running a business so you can focus on barbering.
v2_problem_point_2: Business support when you need it.
v2_problem_point_3: A community that wants you to grow.
v2_optional_services: Additional services are optional and paid separately.
v2_independence_title: Try independent work for one full day.
v2_independence_text: Independence Day is a low-pressure way to feel the space, meet the people and understand how your business could work here.
v2_independence_special: If you join within 30 days, the full €29.99 is credited toward your first membership payment.
v2_how_1_text: Choose the day and confirm your visit.
v2_how_2_text: Use the workspace like a real working day.
v2_how_3_text: Feel the flow, the atmosphere and the support around you.
v2_how_4_text: No pressure. Continue only if Barbers HUB is right for you.
v2_founder_title: Freedom and support should exist together.
v2_founder_text: I worked in traditional chair rental shops where support ended after receiving the chair. I built Barbers HUB because I believe independent barbers deserve freedom and support. When our barbers earn more, we succeed too.
v2_flex_10_text: For flexible growth without a monthly commitment.
v2_flex_15_text: For more consistent work while building your client rhythm.
v2_success_title: We measure success by how far barbers grow.
v2_success_text: One of our first barbers has already opened his own shop. That's exactly the outcome we want.
v2_faq_text: Independence Day is built to answer them in practice, without pressure or a long-term commitment.
v2_faq_1: Can I bring my own clients? Yes.
v2_faq_2: Do I keep my prices and income? Yes.
v2_faq_3: Do I need to commit long term? No.
v2_faq_4: Can I ask business questions during the day? Yes.
